info.name: RFP HITL Approval Workflow
info.description: Human-in-the-Loop approval workflow for RFP proposal generation

request.description: Process RFP through all agents and generate editable proposal draft. No PDF is created yet - it awaits human approval.
Retrieve the editable proposal draft for human review. Copy the 'proposal_draft' object from the response to edit and use in the approval step.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Response Proposal for Retail Paint Procurement",
  "sections": {
    "Executive Summary": "We are pleased to submit our comprehensive proposal for your paint procurement needs. Our solution offers premium quality products with competitive pricing and reliable delivery.",
    "Understanding of Requirements": "• Client requires high-quality, durable paint products
• Budget allocation: ₹200,000
• Delivery timeline: 2 weeks
• Focus on weather-resistant solutions
• Professional-grade finish required",
    "Proposed Solution": "• Asian Paints Royale Premium Interior - Superior finish and durability
• Weather Shield Exterior Coating - 10-year protection guarantee
• Professional-grade application tools included
• Color consultation service provided
• Technical support throughout installation",
    "Pricing Details": "• SKU001 - Asian Paints Royale (Premium) - Qty: 50 units - Unit Price: ₹2,400 - Subtotal: ₹120,000
• SKU002 - Weather Shield Coating - Qty: 30 units - Unit Price: ₹1,800 - Subtotal: ₹54,000
• Application Tools & Accessories - ₹8,000
• Technical Consultation - Complimentary
• Subtotal: ₹182,000
• GST (18%): ₹32,760
• Grand Total: ₹214,760",
    "Payment Terms": "• 30% advance payment (₹64,428) - Upon order confirmation
• 40% on delivery (₹85,904) - Before unloading
• 30% post-installation (₹64,428) - Within 7 days of completion
• Payment methods: Bank transfer, Cheque, or UPI
• Late payment penalty: 2% per month",
    "Implementation Timeline": "• Day 1-2: Order processing and quality check
• Day 3-5: Manufacturing and packaging
• Day 6-7: Transportation and delivery
• Day 8-10: Installation and application support
• Day 11-14: Quality inspection and final touches
• Total Duration: 14 days from order confirmation",
    "Terms and Conditions": "• Product Warranty: 2 years against manufacturing defects
• Price Validity: 30 days from proposal date
• Delivery Terms: FOB Destination
• Force Majeure: Standard clauses apply
• Dispute Resolution: Arbitration in Delhi jurisdiction
• Cancellation Policy: 10% cancellation fee if canceled after confirmation"
  },
  "approved": true
}

request.description: Approve the edited proposal and generate final PDF. Edit the sections in the body before sending. Set 'approved: true' to generate PDF, or 'approved: false' to reject.
Reject the proposal if changes are needed. Sets status to 'revision_needed'.
